reviews.title: Delectable deleted my library
reviews.text: I had over 600 wines saved and Delectable deleted all but about 25 of them

reviews.title: app is going downhill fast
reviews.text: app hardly works - very inconsistent and it's a shame because when it works it's a great community and a great resource when looking for feedback when purchasing

reviews.title: Archived
reviews.text: Broken and hasn’t been. Updated in 4 years. 349 reviews of wine lost 🫠

reviews.title: Abandoned app
reviews.text: App is no longer supported. Basic functionality no longer works.

reviews.title: Mislabels Wines
reviews.text: This app constantly pulls up the wrong wines when the label is clearly visible.

reviews.title: No longer works
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years and it’s been great but now my following feed hasn’t updated in weeks and I can no longer tag people that I’ve shared a bottle with.  It’s a shame because I had over 2300 wines and now I’m going to have to start over in some other app

reviews.title: No one responds
reviews.text: I used to love this app. In fact, I have almost 300 reviews with it. Now, I can’t upload a pic. I’ve reached out several times and no on ever responds. It’s a shame bc I’ve been a Delectable user 10 years.
